definition: a very thin layer of something
description: On a wet city rooftop under dark clouds at sunset, a young woman in a yellow rain jacket lifts a large metal rectangle out of a long trough of soapy water. A thin, shiny soap film stretches across it, shimmering with rainbow colours and billowing in the wind as she raises it higher. A young man crouches behind it and reaches up to touch the soap film with his fingers, while another person holds up a small wind meter. Skyscrapers and a water tower rise in the background.

en.question: What is the woman in yellow doing?

de.answer: Sie hebt einen großen Metallrahmen an.
